title: Fleece
description: The fleece from one shearing. Draft for comment. Not final.

id.description: A short id for this fleece.

shearingId.description: The id of the shearing this fleece came from.

weightGrams.description: Fleece weight in grams, as weighed after shearing.

micron.description: Average fiber width in microns. Leave this out if the fleece was not measured.

color.description: Fleece color, such as white or pearl.

sharing.description: What the rancher chooses to share from this record. Nothing is shared unless the rancher picks it.

audience.description: Who may see this record. private means only the rancher. buyers means people who buy fiber from this ranch. public means anyone.

fields.description: The fields in this record that the audience may see. Fields not listed stay private. The id is always shared so records can link.
